title: Fisher Random Walk: Automatic Debiasing Contextual Preference Inference for Large Language Model Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not evaluate social or demographic bias. Instead, it focuses on mitigating mathematical/statistical bias (specifically, the estimator bias induced by nuisance parameter estimation rates in a plug-in estimator) in the contextual Bradley-Terry-Luce model. It evaluates this by aggregating weighted residual balancing terms using a Fisher random walk across an LLM comparison graph.
